meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 它会扫描你指定的知识库目录（含 index.md、带 wikilink 的 markdown、raw 源文件等），提取文章、来源、主题节点并补出隐式关联，最后保存一份可交互的知识图谱，并自动打开仪表盘展示。
howto.when: 当你说要分析某个知识库目录，或直接带上 wiki 目录路径运行该技能时接管；没给路径就默认分析当前工作目录。

say.text: 分析 ./my-wiki 这个知识库，生成知识图谱
say.note: 先检测格式，再扫描、分析、保存图谱

say.text: 帮我可视化 docs/wiki 里的实体和主题关系
say.note: 按 index.md 的分类分层并排布图谱

say.text: 重新分析当前目录的知识库并打开仪表盘

howto.what_en: It scans a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki directory, extracts article, source and topic nodes, infers implicit links, then saves an interactive knowledge graph and auto-opens the dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze a wiki directory, or run the skill with a directory path; without a path it analyzes the current working directory.

say_en.text: Analyze ./my-wiki and generate a knowledge graph
say_en.note: Detects format, scans, analyzes, saves the graph
